featured_reviews.name: John Christ
featured_reviews.review_text:
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. Period.
Now let me explain. Before visiting this Spa, I read reviews and its not what you want. I like trying new places so, I took the shot. The place is exact opposite of The Capital Mall and the spa is in the shop(ground floor). Let's talk about the massage, I had Linda for the Balinese massage and first I was skeptical because its not your usual "Spa rooms", but the charges they take are very reasonable than the competitors with average massage experience. Linda surprised me with her Balinese massage and I was surprised because the same experience I used to get when I visited the Church gate Spa's as well. Yes there is no music but for me, the massage was important than ambience and music. I even tipped the masseuse because she has good experience of the types of massage and was very communicative. Note: If you want medium to light pressure massage, please communicate to them, they will accordingly do it. Just because they start with hard pressure, you don't have to stick with it. I wanted medium and they delivered the experience as asked. Improvements can be done like add a little music to the massage rooms for a much better experience and hot shower pressure needs to be increased.
Verdict - If you are someone who just wants "better massage" > ambience with average massage, this is the place, very pocket friendly than the neighborhood spa services in this location. I wish people could leave them a good review, even though the counter manager manages it with the baby in hand at the same time. Keep up the good work, Moon Spa. I will be visiting regularly.

featured_reviews.name: Rutuja Mukane
featured_reviews.review_text:
DANGEROUS, DECEPTIVE & COMPLETELY INAPPROPRIATE — AVOID THIS PLACE!

I brought my mother here hoping she’d have a peaceful massage. Instead, she was subjected to a disgusting experience. The staff repeatedly offered “extra services” with sexual undertones—completely inappropriate and unwanted. Even after she clearly said NO multiple times, they kept pushing, including suggesting a male masseuse for “better experience.” This is not a real spa. This is harassment.

They also forced us to pay the full amount upfront, refusing to even begin until the money was taken—clearly because they know no one would pay afterward once they realize how shady and uncomfortable this place is.

The massage was unprofessional, rushed, and borderline threatening. The oil used was cheap and smelly, not the olive oil they promised. The steam room was broken, and when she was asked to walk in a towel to another room (with no privacy, men nearby, and no bathrobe provided) she had to wear her oily clothes just to maintain dignity.

The second steam room was dangerously hot and foggy, and staff kept brushing off her concerns, saying it was “normal.” She walked out of there shaken, angry, and humiliated.

This place should not be allowed to operate. It is unsafe for women and highly unethical.

featured_reviews.name: Asavari Waingankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
THE MOST WORST PLACE I HAVE EVER VISITED...
I and my husband visit for a couple massage. We were asked to be in separate rooms. They said 4500 for 1 hour couple massage with steam and shower.  Used towels are given. Unprofessional staff with Zero KNOWLEDGE of Massage. Only 20 mins massage was given and then asked to take bath in a dirty bathroom. No steam given. The massage girl asked my husband "Do you need special service we give please ask at counter". And the massage girl for me asked me "female can also opt for male services which is given by our sir do u want to talk with them".

Such a bad and scary experience me and my husband left within 35 minutes without taking the shower and steam which was not even working.

I request all of u never visit this place they are very very bad people who ask u for OTHER EXTRA SERVICE.

featured_reviews.name: Manivarane Kounder
featured_reviews.review_text:
This could be the worst spa in Virar. The reviews you read are all paid, so don’t fall into that trap. The guy at the counter, Sammer, is extremely rude and arrogant. They charge high prices and talk about quality, but once you enter the room, the therapists don’t know anything about massage. Instead, they spend the time talking about their personal problems and even try to force you into taking extra services. If you decline, they become rude and annoyed, even going as far as acting crazy if you don’t tip them.

Everything about this place feels like a scam and a money-laundering scheme. I shared my feedback with the person at the counter before posting this review, but he arrogantly dismissed it, saying, “Do whatever you want.” When I asked for a supervisor's contact number to report my experience, he flat-out refused to provide it. So here I am, sharing my experience in this review.
